annotations.title: Create a shareable graph board for a person

description: Build a graph board from up to 10 seed nodes (each expanded to depth 1 or 2) plus up to 50 notes you add, store it, and return a url a person can open on seraphixsystems.com to explore and keep editing. Use it to hand research to a human: seed the companies involved and attach notes (each note may name the node it is about and its source). The board is public to anyone with the link; never put private or personal information in notes.

depth.description: How far to expand each seed (1-2, default 1).

notes.description: Notes to add: each has a label, text, optional https url, the node it is about (attach_to), a link label and its source.

seeds.description: Up to 10 company names, SEC CIKs or node ids to start from.

title.description: Board title shown to the person.

name: create_board
